Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Karan - 34 years, son
Look: moustache, checked shirt
2. Nitin - 59 years, father
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
3. Meenakshi - 55 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The hospital ward - white beds, a drip stand
2. The office - desks, computers, a glass wall

Scene 1: The hospital ward - Day

[Karan stands in the ward. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Meenakshi: "Karan, what's the plan today?"

[Karan sits in a wheelchair.]

Karan: "Really?"

[Karan walks to the reception desk and asks for the doctor.]

Karan (laughing): "Okay, Mom."

[Karan coughs and holds his chest.]

Karan: "Okay, Mom."

Scene 2: The office - Day

[Karan stands in the office. Nitin stands near him.]

Nitin: "Let's begin."

[Karan clutches his chest, collapses with a heart attack and dies.]

Nitin: "We will never forget you."
